items.question: Trong câu "It must satisfy two properties at all times:", từ "satisfy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It must satisfy two properties at all times:", what does "satisfy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (động từ): đáp ứng, thỏa mãn. "Satisfy a property / a condition" = thỏa mãn một tính chất / điều kiện; heap phải luôn thỏa mãn hai tính chất.
items.explanationEn: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (verb): to meet a condition. "Satisfy a property / a condition" means to meet it; a heap must always meet both properties.

items.question: Trong câu "Heap property (order): in a max heap every parent is greater than or equal to its children; in a min heap every parent is less than or equal to its children.", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Heap property (order): in a max heap every parent is greater than or equal to its children; in a min heap every parent is less than or equal to its children.", what does "property" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính chất, đặc tính. "Heap property" = tính chất heap; trong toán/CS, property là tính chất luôn đúng, không phải "tài sản".
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (noun): a defining characteristic. "Heap property" is a rule that always holds; in maths and CS a property is a characteristic, not something owned.

items.question: Trong câu "Shape property: the tree is complete — every level is completely full except possibly the last, and the last level is filled from left to right with no gaps.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Shape property: the tree is complete — every level is completely full except possibly the last, and the last level is filled from left to right with no gaps.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): khoảng trống. "With no gaps" = không có chỗ trống; cụm liên quan: "fill the gap" (lấp chỗ trống).
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): an empty space. "With no gaps" means without empty spaces; related: "fill the gap".

items.question: Trong câu "Consequences of the two rules:", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consequences of the two rules:", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hệ quả. "As a consequence" = do đó, kết quả là; hệ quả là điều suy ra từ các quy tắc.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result. "As a consequence" means as a result; consequences are what follow from the rules.

items.question: Trong câu "A complete tree with n nodes has height ⌊log₂ n⌋, so a heap can never degenerate into a long chain.", từ "degenerate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A complete tree with n nodes has height ⌊log₂ n⌋, so a heap can never degenerate into a long chain.", what does "degenerate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: degenerate /dɪˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): suy biến dần. "Degenerate into a chain/list" = suy biến thành chuỗi/danh sách; hay dùng khi cây mất cân bằng.
items.explanationEn: degenerate /dɪˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to decline into worse. "Degenerate into a chain/list" means to decline into a worse shape; common for unbalanced trees.

items.question: Trong câu "The two variants are mirror images:", từ "variant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two variants are mirror images:", what does "variant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: variant /ˈveə.ri.ənt/ (danh từ): biến thể. "Two variants" = hai biến thể; max heap và min heap là hai biến thể của cùng một cấu trúc.
items.explanationEn: variant /ˈveə.ri.ənt/ (noun): a different form. "Two variants" means two slightly different forms; max and min heaps are variants of one structure.

items.question: Trong câu "The two variants are mirror images:", từ "mirror image" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two variants are mirror images:", what does "mirror image" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mirror image /ˈmɪr.ər ˌɪm.ɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): hình đối xứng. "A mirror image of" = hình đối xứng / phiên bản đảo ngược của; max heap là min heap đảo chiều so sánh.
items.explanationEn: mirror image /ˈmɪr.ər ˌɪm.ɪdʒ/ (phrase): a reversed copy. "A mirror image of" means a reversed version of; a max heap is a min heap with comparisons reversed.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no implied ordering between siblings or between different subtrees: in the max heap above, 39 is on the left and 33 on the right, but 18 (left subtree) is smaller than 33 (right subtree).", từ "imply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no implied ordering between siblings or between different subtrees: in the max heap above, 39 is on the left and 33 on the right, but 18 (left subtree) is smaller than 33 (right subtree).", what does "imply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): ngụ ý, ngầm định. "Implied ordering" = thứ tự ngầm định; đừng nhầm với "apply" (áp dụng).
items.explanationEn: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to suggest indirectly. "Implied ordering" means an order suggested but not stated; do not confuse with "apply".

items.question: Trong câu "There is no implied ordering between siblings or between different subtrees: in the max heap above, 39 is on the left and 33 on the right, but 18 (left subtree) is smaller than 33 (right subtree).", từ "sibling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no implied ordering between siblings or between different subtrees: in the max heap above, 39 is on the left and 33 on the right, but 18 (left subtree) is smaller than 33 (right subtree).", what does "sibling" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the top node of a tree
items.explanation: sibling /ˈsɪb.lɪŋ/ (danh từ): nút anh em. "Siblings" = anh chị em; trong cây là các nút có cùng nút cha. Heap không sắp thứ tự giữa chúng.
items.explanationEn: sibling /ˈsɪb.lɪŋ/ (noun): a node sharing a parent. "Siblings" are brothers and sisters; in a tree, nodes sharing a parent. A heap does not order them.

items.question: Trong câu "A heap is weakly ordered: it gives up full ordering in exchange for cheap access to the extreme value.", từ "in exchange for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A heap is weakly ordered: it gives up full ordering in exchange for cheap access to the extreme value.", what does "in exchange for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in exchange for /ɪn ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ fɔːr/ (cụm từ): để đổi lấy. "Give up X in exchange for Y" = hy sinh X để đổi lấy Y; cách diễn đạt trade-off rất hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: in exchange for /ɪn ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ fɔːr/ (phrase): in return for. "Give up X in exchange for Y" means trading X to get Y; a common way to describe a trade-off.

items.question: Trong câu "A heap is weakly ordered: it gives up full ordering in exchange for cheap access to the extreme value.", từ "extreme" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A heap is weakly ordered: it gives up full ordering in exchange for cheap access to the extreme value.", what does "extreme" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: at the very top or bottom
items.explanation: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (tính từ): cực trị (lớn/nhỏ nhất). "The extreme value" = giá trị cực trị (max hoặc min); nghĩa khác "extreme" là cực đoan.
items.explanationEn: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (adjective): at the very top or bottom. "The extreme value" is the maximum or minimum; another sense of "extreme" is radical.

items.question: Trong câu "Heaps shine whenever you repeatedly need "the most important item right now" while new items keep arriving:", từ "shine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Heaps shine whenever you repeatedly need "the most important item right now" while new items keep arriving:", what does "shine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shine /ʃaɪn/ (động từ): phát huy ưu thế. "X shines when..." = X phát huy thế mạnh khi...; nghĩa đen là chiếu sáng.
items.explanationEn: shine /ʃaɪn/ (verb): to perform very well. "X shines when..." means X performs especially well then; the literal sense is to give off light.

items.question: Trong câu "Graph algorithms — Dijkstra's shortest path and Prim's minimum spanning tree repeatedly extract the closest vertex.", từ "extract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Graph algorithms — Dijkstra's shortest path and Prim's minimum spanning tree repeatedly extract the closest vertex.", what does "extract" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (động từ): lấy ra, rút ra. "Extract the min/max" = lấy phần tử nhỏ/lớn nhất ra khỏi cấu trúc; nghĩa khác: giải nén tệp.
items.explanationEn: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (verb): to take out. "Extract the min/max" means to remove it from the structure; another sense is to unzip a file.

items.question: Trong câu "Priority queues — the heap is the standard implementation (JavaScript has none built in; Java has PriorityQueue, Python has heapq, C++ has priority_queue).", từ "implementation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Priority queues — the heap is the standard implementation (JavaScript has none built in; Java has PriorityQueue, Python has heapq, C++ has priority_queue).", what does "implementation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): cách cài đặt. "The standard implementation" = cách cài đặt tiêu chuẩn; động từ là "implement".
items.explanationEn: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a concrete build. "The standard implementation" is the usual way it is built; the verb is "implement".

items.question: Trong câu "Top-k problems — the k largest scores in a stream, the k closest points, merging k sorted lists.", từ "stream" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Top-k problems — the k largest scores in a stream, the k closest points, merging k sorted lists.", what does "stream" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stream /striːm/ (danh từ): luồng dữ liệu. "In a stream" = trong luồng dữ liệu đến liên tục, không biết trước hết số lượng; nghĩa đen: dòng suối.
items.explanationEn: stream /striːm/ (noun): a flow of data. "In a stream" means in data that keeps arriving; the literal sense is a small river.

items.question: Trong câu "Because a heap is always complete, we do not need node objects with left/right pointers.", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because a heap is always complete, we do not need node objects with left/right pointers.", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪn.tər/ (danh từ): con trỏ. "Left/right pointers" = con trỏ trái/phải trỏ tới nút con; nghĩa khác: con trỏ chuột hoặc lời gợi ý.
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪn.tər/ (noun): a reference. "Left/right pointers" reference child nodes; other senses are a mouse arrow or a hint.

items.question: Trong câu "Read the tree level by level, left to right, and write the values into an array:", từ "level by level" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the tree level by level, left to right, and write the values into an array:", what does "level by level" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: level by level /ˈlev.əl baɪ ˈlev.əl/ (cụm từ): lần lượt từng tầng. "Level by level" = đi hết tầng này rồi sang tầng kế; cùng mẫu với "step by step", "one by one".
items.explanationEn: level by level /ˈlev.əl baɪ ˈlev.əl/ (phrase): one tier at a time. "Level by level" means finishing one tier before the next; same pattern as "step by step".

items.question: Trong câu "This only works because the tree is complete: there are never holes in the array.", từ "hole" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This only works because the tree is complete: there are never holes in the array.", what does "hole" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hole /həʊl/ (danh từ): chỗ trống, lỗ hổng. "Holes in the array" = các ô trống trong mảng; "security hole" lại là lỗ hổng bảo mật.
items.explanationEn: hole /həʊl/ (noun): an empty slot. "Holes in the array" are empty slots; a "security hole" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", từ "benefit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", what does "benefit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: benefit /ˈben.ɪ.fɪt/ (danh từ): lợi ích. "Benefits" = lợi ích, ưu điểm; cụm hay gặp: "benefit from" (hưởng lợi từ).
items.explanationEn: benefit /ˈben.ɪ.fɪt/ (noun): an advantage. "Benefits" are advantages; common phrase: "benefit from".

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", từ "overhead" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", what does "overhead" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overhead /ˈəʊ.və.hed/ (danh từ): chi phí phụ. "Pointer overhead" = bộ nhớ tốn thêm cho con trỏ; nghĩa trạng từ "overhead" là ở trên đầu.
items.explanationEn: overhead /ˈəʊ.və.hed/ (noun): extra cost. "Pointer overhead" is extra memory spent on pointers; as an adverb "overhead" means above.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", từ "locality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", what does "locality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: locality /ləʊˈkæl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính cục bộ, gần nhau. "Cache locality" = dữ liệu nằm liền nhau nên CPU cache đọc nhanh; nghĩa thường: địa phương.
items.explanationEn: locality /ləʊˈkæl.ə.ti/ (noun): data kept close together. "Cache locality" means data sits close together so the CPU cache reads it fast; the everyday sense is a local area.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", từ "navigation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", what does "navigation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: navigation /ˌnæv.ɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự điều hướng. "Navigation to parent or child" = di chuyển tới nút cha/con; "navigation bar" = thanh điều hướng.
items.explanationEn: navigation /ˌnæv.ɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): moving between places. "Navigation to parent or child" means moving to them; a "navigation bar" is a menu.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): đơn giản, bình thường. "Plain arithmetic / plain array" = phép tính / mảng bình thường, không có gì đặc biệt.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): simple, ordinary. "Plain arithmetic / plain array" means ordinary, with nothing special added.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", từ "arithmetic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: no pointer overhead, excellent cache locality, and O(1) navigation to parent or child with plain arithmetic.", what does "arithmetic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: arithmetic /əˈrɪθ.mə.tɪk/ (danh từ): số học. "Index arithmetic" = tính chỉ số bằng cộng, nhân, chia như 2n + 1.
items.explanationEn: arithmetic /əˈrɪθ.mə.tɪk/ (noun): basic number math. "Index arithmetic" means computing indices with operations like 2n + 1.

items.question: Trong câu "A child index ≥ length means that child does not exist.", từ "exist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A child index ≥ length means that child does not exist.", what does "exist" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exist /ɪɡˈzɪst/ (động từ): tồn tại. "Does not exist" = không tồn tại; đừng nhầm với "exit" (thoát).
items.explanationEn: exist /ɪɡˈzɪst/ (verb): to be present. "Does not exist" means is not there; do not confuse with "exit".

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble up (also called sift up, percolate up, heapify up): while the new value is larger than its parent, swap them.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble up (also called sift up, percolate up, heapify up): while the new value is larger than its parent, swap them.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): hoán đổi. "Swap A with B" = đổi chỗ A và B; cũng dùng làm danh từ: "a swap".
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to exchange. "Swap A with B" means exchange their positions; also a noun: "a swap".

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble up (also called sift up, percolate up, heapify up): while the new value is larger than its parent, swap them.", từ "sift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble up (also called sift up, percolate up, heapify up): while the new value is larger than its parent, swap them.", what does "sift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sift /sɪft/ (động từ): sàng, lọc dần. "Sift up / sift down" = đẩy phần tử lên / xuống qua từng tầng; nghĩa gốc: sàng bột.
items.explanationEn: sift /sɪft/ (verb): to filter gradually. "Sift up / sift down" moves an element through the levels; the original sense is to sieve flour.

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble up (also called sift up, percolate up, heapify up): while the new value is larger than its parent, swap them.", từ "percolate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble up (also called sift up, percolate up, heapify up): while the new value is larger than its parent, swap them.", what does "percolate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: percolate /ˈpɜː.kəl.eɪt/ (động từ): thấm dần qua. "Percolate up/down" = di chuyển dần lên/xuống; nghĩa gốc: nước thấm qua lớp cà phê.
items.explanationEn: percolate /ˈpɜː.kəl.eɪt/ (verb): to pass slowly through. "Percolate up/down" means to move gradually; originally water passing through coffee.

items.question: Trong câu "Trace — insert 55 into [41, 39, 33, 18, 27, 12]:", từ "trace" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trace — insert 55 into [41, 39, 33, 18, 27, 12]:", what does "trace" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trace /treɪs/ (danh từ): bản chạy từng bước. "A trace" = mô phỏng từng bước thuật toán; "stack trace" = dấu vết lời gọi hàm.
items.explanationEn: trace /treɪs/ (noun): a step-by-step walk-through. "A trace" walks through an algorithm step by step; a "stack trace" lists function calls.

items.question: Trong câu "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", từ "climb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", what does "climb" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: climb /klaɪm/ (động từ): đi lên. "Climb one level" = đi lên một tầng; trái nghĩa: "sink" (chìm xuống).
items.explanationEn: climb /klaɪm/ (verb): to move up. "Climb one level" means move up one tier; the opposite here is "sink".

items.question: Trong câu "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): một lần lặp (vòng lặp). "Per iteration" = mỗi vòng lặp; trong quản lý dự án, "iteration" còn là một chu kỳ phát triển.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one pass of a loop. "Per iteration" means each pass of the loop; in projects it can also mean a development cycle.

items.question: Trong câu "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", từ "amortized" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", what does "amortized" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: amortized /əˈmɔː.taɪzd/ (tính từ): tính bình quân. "Amortized O(1)" = trung bình O(1) khi chia chi phí thỉnh thoảng tốn kém cho nhiều thao tác; nghĩa tài chính: khấu hao, trả dần.
items.explanationEn: amortized /əˈmɔː.taɪzd/ (adjective): averaged over many operations. "Amortized O(1)" averages occasional expensive steps over many operations; the finance sense is paying off gradually.

items.question: Trong câu "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", từ "occasionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", what does "occasionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: occasionally /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): thỉnh thoảng. "Occasionally" = thỉnh thoảng, không thường xuyên; mạnh hơn "rarely" và yếu hơn "often".
items.explanationEn: occasionally /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl.i/ (adverb): from time to time. "Occasionally" means from time to time; more often than "rarely", less than "often".

items.question: Trong câu "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", từ "resize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The value climbs at most one level per iteration, so insert is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space (amortized, since push occasionally resizes the array).", what does "resize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resize /ˌriːˈsaɪz/ (động từ): thay đổi kích thước. "Resize the array" = cấp phát lại mảng lớn hơn; tiền tố "re-" nghĩa là làm lại.
items.explanationEn: resize /ˌriːˈsaɪz/ (verb): to change the size. "Resize the array" means reallocate it with a new size; the prefix "re-" means again.

items.question: Trong câu "Why the larger child? If 12 were swapped with 33 instead of 39, then 33 would become the parent of 39 — a new violation.", từ "violation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why the larger child? If 12 were swapped with 33 instead of 39, then 33 would become the parent of 39 — a new violation.", what does "violation" (noun) mean?
options: sự xâm phạm quyền riêng tư
items.explanation: violation /ˌvaɪəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự vi phạm (quy tắc). "A heap violation" = chỗ vi phạm tính chất heap; động từ: "violate a rule".
items.explanationEn: violation /ˌvaɪəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a breaking of a rule. "A heap violation" is a place where the heap property is broken; verb: "violate a rule".

items.question: Trong câu "Promoting the larger child guarantees the new parent beats both children.", từ "promote" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Promoting the larger child guarantees the new parent beats both children.", what does "promote" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: promote /prəˈməʊt/ (động từ): đưa lên cao hơn. "Promote the child" = đưa nút con lên vị trí cha; nghĩa khác: quảng bá, thăng chức.
items.explanationEn: promote /prəˈməʊt/ (verb): to move up a rank. "Promote the child" means move it up to the parent position; other senses: advertise, give a higher job.

items.question: Trong câu "Promoting the larger child guarantees the new parent beats both children.", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Promoting the larger child guarantees the new parent beats both children.", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (động từ): đảm bảo chắc chắn. "X guarantees that..." = X đảm bảo chắc chắn rằng...; nghĩa thương mại: bảo hành.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (verb): to make certain. "X guarantees that..." means X makes it certain; the commercial sense is a warranty.

items.question: Trong câu "After pop() the array is empty; writing values[0] = end unconditionally would put the removed value straight back, and the heap would never empty.", từ "unconditionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After pop() the array is empty; writing values[0] = end unconditionally would put the removed value straight back, and the heap would never empty.", what does "unconditionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: unconditionally /ˌʌn.kənˈdɪʃ.ən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): vô điều kiện. "Unconditionally" = luôn làm, không có if kiểm tra trước; tiền tố "un-" phủ định "conditionally".
items.explanationEn: unconditionally /ˌʌn.kənˈdɪʃ.ən.əl.i/ (adverb): with no condition. "Unconditionally" means always, with no if check first; "un-" negates "conditionally".

items.question: Trong câu "Two classic bugs this version avoids:", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two classic bugs this version avoids:", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (tính từ): kinh điển, điển hình. "A classic bug" = lỗi điển hình ai cũng hay mắc; "classical music" mới là nhạc cổ điển.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (adjective): typical and well known. "A classic bug" is a typical, well-known mistake; "classical music" is the other sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Extract max is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space: the element sinks at most the height of the tree.", từ "sink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Extract max is O(log n) time and O(1) extra space: the element sinks at most the height of the tree.", what does "sink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sink /sɪŋk/ (động từ): chìm xuống. "Sink down" = phần tử đi xuống các tầng dưới; danh từ "sink" là bồn rửa, đừng nhầm với "sync".
items.explanationEn: sink /sɪŋk/ (verb): to move down. "Sink down" means move toward lower levels; the noun "sink" is a basin, not "sync".

items.question: Trong câu "A min heap is the same code with the comparisons flipped.", từ "flip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A min heap is the same code with the comparisons flipped.", what does "flip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: flip /flɪp/ (động từ): đảo ngược. "With the comparisons flipped" = đổi chiều các phép so sánh (> thành <); "flip a coin" = tung đồng xu.
items.explanationEn: flip /flɪp/ (verb): to reverse. "With the comparisons flipped" means reversed (> becomes <); "flip a coin" is another sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Rather than writing two classes, pass a comparator: compare(a, b) < 0 means a belongs closer to the root.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rather than writing two classes, pass a comparator: compare(a, b) < 0 means a belongs closer to the root.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈrɑː.ðər ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "Rather than doing X, do Y" = thay vì làm X thì làm Y; đi với V-ing hoặc động từ nguyên mẫu.
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈrɑː.ðər ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. "Rather than doing X, do Y" means choose Y instead of X; followed by -ing or a bare verb.

items.question: Trong câu "Rather than writing two classes, pass a comparator: compare(a, b) < 0 means a belongs closer to the root.", từ "comparator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rather than writing two classes, pass a comparator: compare(a, b) < 0 means a belongs closer to the root.", what does "comparator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: comparator /kəmˈpær.ə.tər/ (danh từ): hàm so sánh. "Pass a comparator" = truyền vào hàm so sánh quyết định thứ tự; giống đối số của Array.sort.
items.explanationEn: comparator /kəmˈpær.ə.tər/ (noun): a comparing function. "Pass a comparator" means supply a function that decides order, like the argument to Array.sort.

items.question: Trong câu "Rather than writing two classes, pass a comparator: compare(a, b) < 0 means a belongs closer to the root.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rather than writing two classes, pass a comparator: compare(a, b) < 0 means a belongs closer to the root.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): nên nằm ở. "A belongs closer to the root" = a nên nằm gần gốc hơn; "belong to" = thuộc về ai.
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (verb): to fit in a place. "A belongs closer to the root" means that is its proper place; "belong to" means be owned by.

items.question: Trong câu "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", từ "abstract" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", what does "abstract" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: abstract /ˈæb.strækt/ (tính từ): trừu tượng. "Abstract data type" = kiểu dữ liệu trừu tượng, chỉ nói làm gì chứ không nói cài đặt thế nào; danh từ "abstract" = bản tóm tắt.
items.explanationEn: abstract /ˈæb.strækt/ (adjective): conceptual, not concrete. "Abstract data type" says what it does, not how it is built; the noun "abstract" is a summary.

items.question: Trong câu "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): được phục vụ. "Served first" = được xử lý trước; cũng dùng "serve a request" (máy chủ phục vụ yêu cầu).
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to be handled. "Served first" means handled before others; also "serve a request" for servers.

items.question: Trong câu "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", từ "regardless of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", what does "regardless of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: regardless of /rɪˈɡɑːd.ləs əv/ (cụm từ): bất kể. "Regardless of insertion order" = không quan tâm thứ tự chèn vào; theo sau là danh từ.
items.explanationEn: regardless of /rɪˈɡɑːd.ləs əv/ (phrase): not affected by. "Regardless of insertion order" means insertion order does not matter; followed by a noun.

items.question: Trong câu "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", từ "insertion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A priority queue is an abstract data type: every element has a priority, and elements with higher priority are served first, regardless of insertion order.", what does "insertion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: insertion /ɪnˈsɜː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự chèn vào. "Insertion order" = thứ tự các phần tử được thêm vào; danh từ của "insert".
items.explanationEn: insertion /ɪnˈsɜː.ʃən/ (noun): the act of putting in. "Insertion order" is the order items were added; noun of "insert".

items.question: Trong câu "A heap is one way to implement it.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A heap is one way to implement it.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): cài đặt, hiện thực hóa. "Implement a priority queue with a heap" = cài đặt hàng đợi ưu tiên bằng heap.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to build in code. "Implement a priority queue with a heap" means build it in code using a heap.

items.question: Trong câu "The naive list forces a full scan on every dequeue; the heap balances both operations.", từ "naive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive list forces a full scan on every dequeue; the heap balances both operations.", what does "naive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (tính từ): đơn giản, chưa tối ưu. "Naive approach/solution" = cách làm thẳng thắn, chưa tối ưu; nghĩa đời thường: ngây thơ, cả tin.
items.explanationEn: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (adjective): simple and unoptimized. "Naive approach/solution" is the obvious unoptimized way; in daily use it means too trusting.

items.question: Trong câu "The naive list forces a full scan on every dequeue; the heap balances both operations.", từ "scan" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive list forces a full scan on every dequeue; the heap balances both operations.", what does "scan" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (danh từ): lượt duyệt hết. "A full scan" = duyệt hết mọi phần tử, tốn O(n); "full table scan" là thuật ngữ trong cơ sở dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (noun): a pass over all items. "A full scan" checks every item, costing O(n); "full table scan" is a database term.

items.question: Trong câu "The naive list forces a full scan on every dequeue; the heap balances both operations.", từ "balance" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive list forces a full scan on every dequeue; the heap balances both operations.", what does "balance" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: balance /ˈbæl.əns/ (động từ): cân bằng. "Balance both operations" = giữ chi phí hai thao tác ngang nhau; danh từ "balance" còn là số dư.
items.explanationEn: balance /ˈbæl.əns/ (verb): to keep even. "Balance both operations" keeps their costs even; the noun "balance" can mean an account total.

items.question: Trong câu "A common convention (used by Dijkstra) is a min heap where a lower number means higher priority:", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common convention (used by Dijkstra) is a min heap where a lower number means higher priority:", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy ước chung. "A common convention" = một quy ước phổ biến; "naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (noun): an agreed practice. "A common convention" is a widely agreed practice; "naming convention" is a related phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "A heap is not stable: two nodes with equal priority can come out in any order.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A heap is not stable: two nodes with equal priority can come out in any order.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): ổn định (giữ thứ tự). "Stable sort/queue" = phần tử bằng nhau giữ nguyên thứ tự ban đầu; nghĩa thường: vững vàng.
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): keeping equal items in order. "Stable sort/queue" keeps equal items in their original order; the everyday sense is firm.

items.question: Trong câu "If FIFO order among ties matters, store an increasing insertion counter and compare it when priorities are equal.", từ "tie" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If FIFO order among ties matters, store an increasing insertion counter and compare it when priorities are equal.", what does "tie" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tie /taɪ/ (danh từ): sự bằng nhau. "Among ties" = giữa các phần tử có giá trị bằng nhau; "break a tie" = phân định khi hòa.
items.explanationEn: tie /taɪ/ (noun): an equal result. "Among ties" means among equal-valued items; "break a tie" means decide between them.

items.question: Trong câu "If FIFO order among ties matters, store an increasing insertion counter and compare it when priorities are equal.", từ "counter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If FIFO order among ties matters, store an increasing insertion counter and compare it when priorities are equal.", what does "counter" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: counter /ˈkaʊn.tər/ (danh từ): biến đếm. "An insertion counter" = biến đếm tăng dần mỗi lần chèn; nghĩa khác: quầy (bán hàng).
items.explanationEn: counter /ˈkaʊn.tər/ (noun): a counting variable. "An insertion counter" increases on each insert; another sense is a shop desk.

items.question: Trong câu "Top-k pattern: to keep the k largest values from a stream of n items, maintain a min heap of size k; when it exceeds k, pop the smallest.", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Top-k pattern: to keep the k largest values from a stream of n items, maintain a min heap of size k; when it exceeds k, pop the smallest.", what does "exceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Exceed k" = lớn hơn k; danh từ liên quan: "excess" (phần dư).
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to go beyond. "Exceed k" means become larger than k; related noun: "excess".

items.question: Trong câu "Top-k pattern: to keep the k largest values from a stream of n items, maintain a min heap of size k; when it exceeds k, pop the smallest.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Top-k pattern: to keep the k largest values from a stream of n items, maintain a min heap of size k; when it exceeds k, pop the smallest.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì, giữ. "Maintain a heap of size k" = luôn giữ một heap kích thước k; nghĩa khác: bảo trì hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep going. "Maintain a heap of size k" means keep it that way; another sense is servicing a system.

items.question: Trong câu "Why log n? A complete tree doubles its capacity with each level: 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15 nodes fit in 4 levels.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why log n? A complete tree doubles its capacity with each level: 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15 nodes fit in 4 levels.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sức chứa. "Doubles its capacity" = sức chứa tăng gấp đôi; nghĩa khác: năng lực, khả năng.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (noun): holding amount. "Doubles its capacity" means it can hold twice as much; another sense is ability.

items.question: Trong câu "Why log n? A complete tree doubles its capacity with each level: 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15 nodes fit in 4 levels.", từ "double" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why log n? A complete tree doubles its capacity with each level: 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15 nodes fit in 4 levels.", what does "double" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (động từ): tăng gấp đôi. "Double" = gấp đôi; tăng gấp đôi mỗi tầng là lý do chiều cao chỉ là log n.
items.explanationEn: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (verb): to grow twofold. "Double" means become twice as large; doubling each level is why height is only log n.

items.question: Trong câu "Why log n? A complete tree doubles its capacity with each level: 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15 nodes fit in 4 levels.", từ "fit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why log n? A complete tree doubles its capacity with each level: 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15 nodes fit in 4 levels.", what does "fit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fit /fɪt/ (động từ): vừa, chứa được trong. "15 nodes fit in 4 levels" = 4 tầng chứa vừa 15 nút; tính từ "fit" = khỏe mạnh.
items.explanationEn: fit /fɪt/ (verb): to have room in. "15 nodes fit in 4 levels" means there is room for them; the adjective "fit" means healthy.

items.question: Trong câu "With 16 elements the new value sits at depth 4, so inserting a new maximum takes at most 4 comparisons and swaps; with a million elements, about 20.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.question: Trong câu "With 16 elements the new value sits at depth 4, so inserting a new maximum takes at most 4 comparisons and swaps; with a million elements, about 20.", từ "comparison" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With 16 elements the new value sits at depth 4, so inserting a new maximum takes at most 4 comparisons and swaps; with a million elements, about 20.", what does "comparison" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: comparison /kəmˈpær.ɪ.sən/ (danh từ): phép so sánh. "4 comparisons" = 4 lần so sánh; số phép so sánh thường dùng để đo chi phí thuật toán.
items.explanationEn: comparison /kəmˈpær.ɪ.sən/ (noun): an act of comparing. "4 comparisons" means comparing four times; counting comparisons measures algorithm cost.

items.question: Trong câu "What about the worst case? A BST fed sorted input turns into a linked list and every operation becomes O(n).", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What about the worst case? A BST fed sorted input turns into a linked list and every operation becomes O(n).", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "Worst case" = trường hợp tệ nhất; "in the worst case" = trong trường hợp xấu nhất.
items.explanationEn: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable scenario. "Worst case" is the least favourable scenario; "in the worst case" is the usual phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "What about the worst case? A BST fed sorted input turns into a linked list and every operation becomes O(n).", từ "feed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What about the worst case? A BST fed sorted input turns into a linked list and every operation becomes O(n).", what does "feed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: feed /fiːd/ (động từ): đưa vào. "A BST fed sorted input" = BST được đưa dữ liệu đã sắp xếp vào; nghĩa gốc: cho ăn.
items.explanationEn: feed /fiːd/ (verb): to supply input. "A BST fed sorted input" means given sorted data; the original sense is to give food.

items.question: Trong câu "What about the worst case? A BST fed sorted input turns into a linked list and every operation becomes O(n).", từ "turn into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What about the worst case? A BST fed sorted input turns into a linked list and every operation becomes O(n).", what does "turn into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): biến thành. "Turn into" = biến thành; tương tự "degenerate into" nhưng trung tính hơn.
items.explanationEn: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to become. "Turn into" means become; similar to "degenerate into" but neutral.

items.question: Trong câu "That cannot happen with a heap: the shape property forces the tree to stay complete, so O(log n) is the worst case, not just the average.", từ "force" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That cannot happen with a heap: the shape property forces the tree to stay complete, so O(log n) is the worst case, not just the average.", what does "force" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: force /fɔːs/ (động từ): buộc phải. "Force X to do Y" = buộc X phải làm Y; "force push" trong git là đẩy ghi đè.
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːs/ (verb): to compel. "Force X to do Y" means make X do Y; "force push" in git is a related use.

items.question: Trong câu "That cannot happen with a heap: the shape property forces the tree to stay complete, so O(log n) is the worst case, not just the average.", từ "average" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That cannot happen with a heap: the shape property forces the tree to stay complete, so O(log n) is the worst case, not just the average.", what does "average" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: average /ˈæv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): mức trung bình. "Not just the average" = không chỉ trong trường hợp trung bình; "on average" = tính trung bình.
items.explanationEn: average /ˈæv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (noun): the typical case. "Not just the average" means not only the typical case; "on average" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Siblings are unordered, so no half can be skipped", từ "unordered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Siblings are unordered, so no half can be skipped", what does "unordered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unordered /ʌnˈɔː.dəd/ (tính từ): không có thứ tự. "Unordered" = không sắp theo thứ tự; vì anh em không có thứ tự nên tìm kiếm là O(n).
items.explanationEn: unordered /ʌnˈɔː.dəd/ (adjective): having no set order. "Unordered" means having no set order; that is why heap search is O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "Siblings are unordered, so no half can be skipped", từ "skip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Siblings are unordered, so no half can be skipped", what does "skip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: skip /skɪp/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "No half can be skipped" = không thể bỏ qua nửa nào như trong tìm kiếm nhị phân.
items.explanationEn: skip /skɪp/ (verb): to pass over. "No half can be skipped" means you cannot pass over half, unlike binary search.

items.question: Trong câu "Naive approach: create an empty heap and insert each of the n elements.", từ "approach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Naive approach: create an empty heap and insert each of the n elements.", what does "approach" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (danh từ): phương pháp. "Naive approach" = cách làm đơn giản chưa tối ưu; động từ "approach" = tiến lại gần.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (noun): a method. "Naive approach" is the simple unoptimized way; the verb "approach" means come closer.

items.question: Trong câu "Each insert is O(log n), so the total is O(n log n).", từ "total" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each insert is O(log n), so the total is O(n log n).", what does "total" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: total /ˈtəʊ.təl/ (danh từ): tổng cộng. "The total is O(n log n)" = tổng chi phí là O(n log n); "in total" = tính tổng cộng.
items.explanationEn: total /ˈtəʊ.təl/ (noun): the whole sum. "The total is O(n log n)" means the whole cost; "in total" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Bottom-up heapify (Floyd's method): treat the array as a complete tree already, then call sinkDown on every non-leaf node from the last parent back to the root.", từ "treat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bottom-up heapify (Floyd's method): treat the array as a complete tree already, then call sinkDown on every non-leaf node from the last parent back to the root.", what does "treat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: treat /triːt/ (động từ): coi như. "Treat X as Y" = coi X như Y; nghĩa khác: chữa trị, hoặc khao ai đó.
items.explanationEn: treat /triːt/ (verb): to regard as. "Treat X as Y" means regard X as Y; other senses: give medical care, pay for someone.

items.question: Trong câu "Bottom-up heapify (Floyd's method): treat the array as a complete tree already, then call sinkDown on every non-leaf node from the last parent back to the root.", từ "bottom-up" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bottom-up heapify (Floyd's method): treat the array as a complete tree already, then call sinkDown on every non-leaf node from the last parent back to the root.", what does "bottom-up" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bottom-up /ˌbɒt.əm ˈʌp/ (tính từ): từ dưới lên. "Bottom-up" = xử lý từ dưới lên; trái nghĩa "top-down". Cũng gặp trong quy hoạch động.
items.explanationEn: bottom-up /ˌbɒt.əm ˈʌp/ (adjective): from the base up. "Bottom-up" means working from the lowest level up; opposite "top-down", also used in dynamic programming.

items.question: Trong câu "Leaves (the second half of the array) are already valid one-node heaps, so the loop starts at index Math.floor(n / 2) - 1.", từ "leaf" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Leaves (the second half of the array) are already valid one-node heaps, so the loop starts at index Math.floor(n / 2) - 1.", what does "leaf" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: leaf /liːf/ (danh từ): nút lá. "Leaves" = số nhiều của "leaf"; trong cây là các nút không có con.
items.explanationEn: leaf /liːf/ (noun): a childless node. "Leaves" is the plural of "leaf"; in a tree, nodes with no children.

items.question: Trong câu "Leaves (the second half of the array) are already valid one-node heaps, so the loop starts at index Math.floor(n / 2) - 1.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Leaves (the second half of the array) are already valid one-node heaps, so the loop starts at index Math.floor(n / 2) - 1.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. "A valid heap" = heap thỏa mọi quy tắc; trái nghĩa "invalid".
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (adjective): meeting the rules. "A valid heap" meets all the rules; opposite "invalid".

items.question: Trong câu "For end from n - 1 down to 1: swap arr[0] (the max) with arr[end], then siftDown(arr, 0, end) to restore the heap in the shrinking prefix.", từ "restore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For end from n - 1 down to 1: swap arr[0] (the max) with arr[end], then siftDown(arr, 0, end) to restore the heap in the shrinking prefix.", what does "restore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (động từ): khôi phục. "Restore the heap" = khôi phục tính chất heap; "restore a backup" = khôi phục bản sao lưu.
items.explanationEn: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (verb): to bring back. "Restore the heap" means bring back the heap property; "restore a backup" is another use.

items.question: Trong câu "For end from n - 1 down to 1: swap arr[0] (the max) with arr[end], then siftDown(arr, 0, end) to restore the heap in the shrinking prefix.", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For end from n - 1 down to 1: swap arr[0] (the max) with arr[end], then siftDown(arr, 0, end) to restore the heap in the shrinking prefix.", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): co lại. "The shrinking prefix" = phần đầu mảng ngày càng ngắn lại; trái nghĩa "grow".
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to get smaller. "The shrinking prefix" is the front part getting smaller; opposite "grow".

items.question: Trong câu "For end from n - 1 down to 1: swap arr[0] (the max) with arr[end], then siftDown(arr, 0, end) to restore the heap in the shrinking prefix.", từ "prefix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For end from n - 1 down to 1: swap arr[0] (the max) with arr[end], then siftDown(arr, 0, end) to restore the heap in the shrinking prefix.", what does "prefix" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the front part of a sequence
items.explanation: prefix /ˈpriː.fɪks/ (danh từ): phần đầu (của dãy). "Prefix" = phần đầu của mảng/chuỗi; trong ngữ pháp là tiền tố như "un-", "re-". Trái nghĩa "suffix".
items.explanationEn: prefix /ˈpriː.fɪks/ (noun): the front part of a sequence. "Prefix" is the front part of an array or string; in grammar, letters like "un-". Opposite "suffix".

items.question: Trong câu "In practice it is often slower than quick sort because it jumps around the array and uses the CPU cache poorly.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice it is often slower than quick sort because it jumps around the array and uses the CPU cache poorly.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. "In practice" = trên thực tế, đối lập với "in theory" (trên lý thuyết).
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (phrase): in real use. "In practice" means in real use, as opposed to "in theory".

items.question: Trong câu "In practice it is often slower than quick sort because it jumps around the array and uses the CPU cache poorly.", từ "poorly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice it is often slower than quick sort because it jumps around the array and uses the CPU cache poorly.", what does "poorly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: poorly /ˈpʊə.li/ (trạng từ): kém. "Uses the cache poorly" = tận dụng bộ nhớ đệm kém; "poorly designed" = thiết kế tệ.
items.explanationEn: poorly /ˈpʊə.li/ (adverb): badly. "Uses the cache poorly" means badly; "poorly designed" is a common collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "No — long-distance swaps reorder equal keys", từ "reorder" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No — long-distance swaps reorder equal keys", what does "reorder" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reorder /riˈɔː.dər/ (động từ): thay đổi thứ tự. "Reorder equal keys" = làm đảo thứ tự các khóa bằng nhau, nên heap sort không ổn định; nghĩa khác: đặt mua lại.
items.explanationEn: reorder /riˈɔː.dər/ (verb): to change the order. "Reorder equal keys" changes their order, so heap sort is unstable; another sense is to buy again.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch the edge cases: empty heap, single-element extract, and indices past the end of the array.", từ "edge case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch the edge cases: empty heap, single-element extract, and indices past the end of the array.", what does "edge case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: edge case /ˈedʒ ˌkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp biên. "Watch the edge cases" = chú ý các trường hợp biên như rỗng, một phần tử.
items.explanationEn: edge case /ˈedʒ ˌkeɪs/ (phrase): a boundary scenario. "Watch the edge cases" means pay attention to boundaries such as empty or single-element input.

items.question: Trong câu "A heap lives in a plain array, navigated with index arithmetic.", từ "navigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A heap lives in a plain array, navigated with index arithmetic.", what does "navigate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: navigate /ˈnæv.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): điều hướng. "Navigated with index arithmetic" = di chuyển giữa các nút bằng tính chỉ số; nghĩa gốc: lái tàu.
items.explanationEn: navigate /ˈnæv.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to move around. "Navigated with index arithmetic" means moving between nodes by computing indices; the original sense is steering a ship.

items.question: Trong câu "Insert bubbles up and extract sinks down, each bounded by the height, O(log n).", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insert bubbles up and extract sinks down, each bounded by the height, O(log n).", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): bị giới hạn bởi. "Bounded by the height" = không vượt quá chiều cao; "upper bound" = cận trên.
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): limited by. "Bounded by the height" means it cannot exceed the height; "upper bound" is related.

items.question: Trong câu "A priority queue built on a heap serves the highest-priority item in O(log n), versus O(n) for a naive list.", từ "versus" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A priority queue built on a heap serves the highest-priority item in O(log n), versus O(n) for a naive list.", what does "versus" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: versus /ˈvɜː.səs/ (giới từ): so với. "X versus Y" = X so với Y; viết tắt "vs".
items.explanationEn: versus /ˈvɜː.səs/ (preposition): compared with. "X versus Y" means X compared with Y; abbreviated "vs".

items.question: Trong câu "Bottom-up heapify builds a heap in O(n), and heap sort uses it to sort in place in O(n log n).", từ "in place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bottom-up heapify builds a heap in O(n), and heap sort uses it to sort in place in O(n log n).", what does "in place" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (cụm từ): tại chỗ. "Sort in place" = sắp xếp ngay trên mảng gốc, O(1) bộ nhớ phụ; "in place" còn có nghĩa đã sẵn sàng.
items.explanationEn: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (phrase): without extra memory. "Sort in place" means within the original array using O(1) extra memory; "in place" can also mean set up and ready.
